title: Kagamine Rin — Mission Accomplished! High Five!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that was good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're done!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Which means...
It's time for that♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, finally♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I thought you guys were kidding...
We're really gonna have a mock wedding?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course! You all heard about what happened at the bridal fair, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got to see where it took place, but I didn't really get to see the wedding bit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, Hona asked if I wanted to do one!
She even made me a veil!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, a veil?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, it's so pretty and silky and sparkly...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. These sorts of delicate fabrics are supposed to be very hard to work with, but you've done a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
It's mostly just some lace attached to the base fabric, really. The ones you normally see are a little too intricate for me to handle.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! But it looks gorgeous! I really like it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin. I'm glad you think so.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, how are we actually doing this mock wedding? Honami, I heard you and the others got to be in a show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A whole show might be a bit much for us, so I think giving the vows will be enough.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it should be fun to imagine being a real bride entering from the other end of the hall.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which means we only need a bride and a minister...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hona, you should walk with me.
Also, I want you to show me what to do!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, what about the minister...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Why not KAITO?
He seems really suited for that role.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, you do seem the type.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, the rest of us will be the wedding guests.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Everyone, let's get to it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm playing it now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this song. It really feels like a wedding now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She downloaded it a second ago because atmosphere is apparently everything for these things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, here they come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ooh, Rin's wearing Hona's veil!
It's so cute on her! Hey, look this way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki, I thought you were taking the video.
The camera's gonna pick up your voice if you don't keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I'm supposed to be the photographer, so I'll need to take lots of pictures.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
One step at a time just like we discussed.
Start with your right foot and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I remember! Then I move my left foot so that it lines up with my right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Rin's actually doing a pretty good job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She and Honami are in perfect lockstep.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, minister, you're up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, so... I just have to read what's written here, right...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you take one another as wedded spouses for better, for worse, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish from this day forth...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course, I...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not so fast!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! Sakki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona! I'm not about to let you become someone's bride since I still need you to be my big, fluffy comfort pillow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, Shiho! Come on, are you really gonna let someone take Hona away like this?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me? Um... I'd like to have more of the snacks and sweets you make, so would you be willing to reconsider?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm not doing this no matter how—

rows.Speaker: Shiho?
rows.Line: “I still need you since you're my partner in the rhythm squad.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-Wait, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha! Hona, you're so popular!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, aren't you supposed to say, “I'm not letting you have her!” or something?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, why don't you all swear to be friends forever?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: D-Do you swear...?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line: I do♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... I do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Weddings don't normally go like this, do they...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I doubt they do...
But it's all in good fun since Rin seems to be enjoying herself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.
